fields.title: Dentō Ichiba Teishi Kaijo ni Kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku (Administrative Report on Lifting Market Closure)

report.subject: Utari binti Arsad no shinsei ni yoru dentō ichiba teishi no kaijo chōsa
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo

fields.summary: Karantina shoki no meirei igo, eisei kijun ga mitasareta tame, ichiba teishi shobun o kaijo shi saikai o tokutei suru hōkoku.
findings: Kensa kekka ni yori shinseisha wa subete no eisei kisei o junsyu shite iru koto ga hanmei shita.
Keizai oyobi chiiki no fukushi no tame ni ichiba no saikai ga datō de aru.
recommendations: Ichiba no un'yō saikai o kyoka shi, kanshi o keizoku suru.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa kensa kekka ni motoduku saikai no dōtoisei o shiji shite iru.
